No, the device is not offline. The feeders I have have worked very reliably for over two years. This morning, I noticed that despite an existing on-device feeding schedule that has run for months on end, one of my cats was not fed this morning, zero food was dispensed and I had to do it by hand. It’s possible it’s happened more over the past couple of days and I didn’t notice. This is EXTREMELY concerning because I’ve trusted these things to feed my cats between daily pet sitter visits while I’m on vacation, but whatever network issues are happening, they seem to be affecting not just the app connection, but on-device data. The app says the device is offline even though the device has a solid wifi icon and reconnects fine after unplugging and plugging in again. If a missed feeding happens again after this week, I’ll have to find another set of feeders. Absolutely insane.
